title: •Guri
caption: •Guri (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. At Coruscant sites where you have a Black Sun Agent, your Force drains are +1. While with Xizor in battle, she may be forfeited to satisfy all remaining battle damage against you. Immune to Restraining Bolt, purchase, and attrition < 5.
lore: Human-replica droid. Programmed to function as Xizor’s personal bodyguard and assassin. Black Sun agent. Cost 9 million credits. Worth every decicred.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 6 / ARMOR 5 / ASSASSIN DROID (label only, as vs5/40 IG-88); deploy 4 / forfeit 6 (printed card 6 / 7). Yellow (DS) pilot-power icon followed by '2.' at the start → {pilot:2} (stub expands 'Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots'). 'Black Sun Agent' capital A as printed on the slip. Icon column top to bottom: pilot (yellow DS helmet), warrior (blue, blaster). Droid (gold grille Droid disc top-left on the base scan; printed icons Pilot, Warrior, Reflections II). Slip text otherwise matches the stub. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Xizor’s (wiki straight). Base scan Ref2-D-guri.gif is 354×492 (no 745 px scan on the wiki); copyright line legible: '© 2000 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2000 DECIPHER INC.'. Modern: Virtual Block 4 only (VB4-D-guri-pre.gif, 354 px; non-pre also exists, not downloaded).
